text: Glory be to my Lord, the Great, three times
Glory be to my Lord, the Great, and praise be to Him, three times
Glory be to the Holy One, Lord of the angels and the spirit
Glory be to You, O God, and with Your praise, O God, forgive me
O God, to You I bowed, and in You I believed, and to You I submitted, my hearing and my sight, my brain, my bones, and my nerves submit to You.
Glory be to Him who has power and kingdom, pride and greatness
